title: Adonijah Sets Himself Up and Solomon Becomes King
description: King David is old, and his son Adonijah sets himself up and has himself proclaimed king with support from Joab and the priest Abiathar. The prophet Nathan and Bathsheba intervene and remind David of his promise that Solomon will inherit the throne. David orders that Solomon be anointed as king at Gihon by the priest Zadok and the prophet Nathan. When Adonijah hears the shouting, he becomes afraid and grabs hold of the horns of the altar to save his life, but Solomon promises to spare him if he proves himself worthy.
